Title: Intelligent Performance for Azure Database for MariaDB is now in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Database for MariaDB now provides preview support for Intelligent Performance, which includes query store, query performance Insights, and performance recommendations. This set of features provides the ability to better understand your workloads, identify bottlenecks, and visually inspect your workloads. Use this functionality to view a list of recommendations to help improve the performance of your workloads.

Learn more about performance insights

Learn more about query store
